title: 第一卷 第9章 受伤中毒
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天色微明，车驾便匆匆离开了慈云庵。

山路崎岖，雾气未散。

刚行至一处较为僻静的山道，两侧树林中骤然响起破空之声！

数道黑影扑出，手中兵刃寒光凛冽，直取苏清婉的马车。

曹无赦派来的四名侍卫反应不慢，立刻拔刀迎上，顿时金铁交鸣。

“有刺客！保护娘娘！”冯安尖声嘶喊，吓得面无人色，缩在车辕下。

叶笙歌心头一紧，下意识将苏清婉护在身后。兰心也扑过来，挡在苏清婉身前，浑身发抖。

刺客显然训练有素，招招狠辣，目标明确。

一名侍卫被砍翻，另一人左支右绌。眼看一名刺客突破拦截，直刺向车厢内的苏清婉！

电光石火间，叶笙歌来不及多想，猛地将苏清婉往旁边一推，自己侧身挡了上去。

“噗嗤——”

剑尖刺入他左肩，一阵剧痛传来，伴随着一股诡异的麻痒感迅速扩散。

有毒！叶笙歌闷哼一声，反手抓住刺客手腕，另一只手摸出随身携带的银针，狠狠刺入对方肘部穴位。

刺客吃痛，动作一滞。

就在这千钧一发之际，一道清越的娇叱声响起：“何方宵小，敢伤我姐姐！”

一道绯红色身影掠过，剑光瞬间卷向那持剑刺客。来人是个年轻女子，约莫十七八岁，眉目如画，却更添飒爽英气，手中一柄长剑使得精妙迅疾。

刺客被她打了个措手不及，仓促回防。

女子剑法凌厉，加之侍卫见她援手，精神一振，合力反击。

眼看刺杀无望，几名刺客对视一眼，竟毫不犹豫地咬碎了口中某物，顷刻间口吐黑血，倒地气绝。

变故只在几个呼吸间。山道上恢复了寂静，只余浓重的血腥气和几具迅速僵硬的尸体。

那绯衣女子还剑入鞘，快步走到马车前，撩开车帘，看到脸色苍白的苏清婉，眼圈一红：“姐姐！凌霜来迟了！”

苏清婉惊魂未定，待看清来人，才失声道：“凌霜？是你！”

原来这女子正是苏清婉的义妹，苏凌霜，自幼被高人收为弟子，离家学艺，近日方才艺成下山。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As the sky dimmed, the driver hurriedly left Ciyun Nunnery.

The mountain road is rugged and the fog has not dispersed.

Just as we reached a relatively secluded mountain road, the sound of breaking through the air suddenly rang out from the woods on both sides!

Several black shadows pounced out, their weapons in their hands gleaming with cold light, heading straight for Su Qingwan's carriage.

The four guards sent by Cao Wushe did not react slowly and immediately drew their swords to meet him. Gold and iron immediately clashed.

"There is an assassin! Protect the empress!" Feng An screamed, his face turned pale with fear, and he huddled under the car's shaft.

Ye Shengge's heart tightened and he subconsciously protected Su Qingwan behind him.Lan Xin also rushed over and stood in front of Su Qingwan, trembling all over.

The assassins were obviously well-trained, with ruthless moves and clear goals.

One guard was chopped down, and the other was left paralyzed.Seeing an assassin break through the interception and stab Su Qingwan in the car!

In the flash of lightning, Ye Shengge didn't have time to think too much. He pushed Su Qingwan aside and stepped in to block him.

"Pfft——"

The tip of the sword pierced his left shoulder, causing a sharp pain, followed by a strange numb and itchy feeling that spread rapidly.

poisonous!Ye Shengge groaned, grabbed the assassin's wrist with his backhand, took out the silver needle he carried with him with his other hand, and stabbed the acupuncture point on the opponent's elbow hard.

The assassin was in pain and his movements were stagnant.

At this critical moment, a Qingyue voice sounded: "How dare you hurt my sister!"

A crimson figure passed by, and the sword light instantly rolled towards the sword-wielding assassin.The person who came was a young woman, about seventeen or eighteen years old. Her features were picturesque, but she was even more valiant and heroic. She had a long sword in her hand that made her delicate and swift.

The assassin was caught off guard by her and hurriedly returned to defense.

The woman's swordsmanship was fierce, and when the guards saw her helping hand, they perked up and joined forces to fight back.

Seeing that there was no hope of assassination, the assassins looked at each other and without hesitation bit something in their mouths. In an instant, they vomited black blood and fell to the ground.

Changes occur in just a few breaths.Silence returned to the mountain road, leaving only the thick smell of blood and a few corpses that stiffened rapidly.

The woman in scarlet clothes sheathed her sword, walked quickly to the carriage, lifted the curtain, and saw the pale Su Qingwan, her eyes turned red: "Sister! Ling Shuang is late!"

Su Qingwan was still in shock. When she saw who was coming, she lost her voice and said, "Ling Shuang? It's you!"

It turns out that this woman is Su Qingwan's foster sister, Su Lingshuang. She was accepted as a disciple by an expert since she was a child. She left home to study martial arts and recently became a talented person.
